posts.subject: Ban apologie by Floppa
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello, there I am Floppa here and I have been banned for 8 houres on the Dream Knife Server. So here is how it has gone:


Someone backstabbed me in a 2v1 and that is not allowed so I wrote something in chat to give a sign to WHAT that he is doing that.
I also tried to contact him in voice chat but was AFK, so that is the moment when I tried to call another admin with the feature '!calladmin' to bring another admin in the knife server who is actually active that moment. And on that moment 2 things happend: My friend asked me to play CSGO mm and WHAT came back. And all that has pissed me off so I decided to play mm with my friend.


And here my are apologies for doing that. Next time I will wait untill the admin comes back.


-Floppa [thanksforit*]

This is my view of this. You are banned for 4 not 8. I was on the server for 2 min, I just joined and I was writing on my phone to a friend so my eyes wasn't on the screen. You wrote my name once. Maybe you where writing twice but pretty sure you wrote my name once. I had voice_enable 1 on, and I had my headphones on and I didn't hear I single player except "HappyDinoPawełele" who was speaking a little. I started moving and you where dead I by common sence you where spectating me and I see the !calladmin fly by in the chat. I handle it I of course I need to stop and when I stopped to handle it you left cause you prob think that I would ban you. That wasn't my first thought. Was going to ask why you did !calladmin when you know very well when there is a admin on the server is not allowed. But you left the game. In my attention to this and experience with you and your friends, you really really like to troll and annoy players/admins. But I have no problem with unbanning you but I just want confirmation from a higher admin that you won't do it again. And btw don't lie and say that you where trying to talk to me, cause I didn't hear anything. And also again, maybe wait 10 seconds instead of instantly do a !calladmin especially when one just joined

Well in previous day I have been trollin' and I also have been anoying people, and that was wrong. Also sorry about that. Can you please already unban me? We can talk pretty much easlier in ingame voicechat.

Hello @haxisy


I have been contacted by @WHAT and his decision was to keep your ban till the end as it expires soon ( 20:11 ) I hope this will not stop you in playing on Dream Community and hope you learn the lesson.


If you're not happy with decision made by WHAT pleas contact people listed --> @Nachtfrische @BlackFire @Sky



Topic Solved, Close please.
